verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party tipping docs list tipping from the terminal and tipping from the POS app as options. With the POS-app option, the customer accepts, changes, or declines a suggested tip on the payment terminal, so terminal-side tip collection is a documented product capability. The pack does not show how a merchant-ops user configures the prompts, and it never mentions percentage presets, smart amounts, or a custom-tip entry option. Missing for 10: documented configuration of percentage tip options, smart/fixed-amount tip logic, custom-tip entry settings, a merchant-facing setup path (e.g., Customer Area), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can configure tipping prompts (percentages, smart amounts, custom tips) collected on the reader or terminal

citations.quote: There are various ways to implement tipping ('gratuity'). These are your options: Tipping from the POS app... Tipping from the terminal... Tipping on the receipt
you add a tip amount to the payment request that you send from your POS app. The customer then accepts, changes, or declines the suggested tip amount on the payment terminal
